title: His frame on their wall
logline: Thursday. The living room. On the wall: the 2003 rough, framed — Gully had it done in Newport, badly, a plastic frame, a mat the wrong color. Wood looks at it for the whole strip and says it's a good frame.

panels.composition: The ranch house's living room. A couch, a lamp, and on the wall, a small frame: the pencil rough of Gully hanging the sign. Plastic frame. Cream mat, wrong. WOOD in front of it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man standing before a small badly framed pencil sketch on a living-room wall, a stocky man and a practical woman behind him, a dog on the couch
image.notes: The 2003 rough (dw_2003-07-08), framed in Newport. Wrong mat. Note: Gully re-frames it properly in May 2011 (dw_2011-05-18).

panels.composition: The frame. The mat's edge cut crooked. A bubble under the glass. Wood's eyes, cataloguing every fault.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, close-up of a cheap plastic frame with a crookedly cut mat and a bubble under the glass, a man's eyes on it

panels.composition: Gully, behind him, waiting for it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man waiting for a verdict from a thin man who is looking at a frame

panels.composition: Maria, from the kitchen door, the head-shake — at Gully, for asking. Wood still looking at the rough. The dog asleep on a couch he's not allowed on.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a practical woman in a kitchen doorway giving a small head-shake to a stocky man while a thin man keeps looking at a framed sketch, a dog asleep on the couch, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: 'It's a good frame, Gully.' The head-shake. He'll re-do it in 2011.
